articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5 in early August 2026, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a larger effective context window. Benchmarks show marked gains on PhD-level science questions and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts in several fields.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini Ultra 2, which sets new records on agentic task-completion benchmarks including SWE-bench and WebArena. The model introduces improved tool-use chaining and persistent memory across sessions, enabling it to autonomously complete multi-hour software engineering workflows with minimal human oversight.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure's third-generation humanoid robot has entered full commercial deployment at BMW's Spartanburg plant, performing bin-picking, parts transport, and quality inspection tasks alongside human workers. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation, marking one of the largest humanoid deployments in automotive manufacturing to date.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Multi-Floor Warehouse Operations
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated an updated electric Atlas humanoid completing end-to-end warehouse fulfillment tasks across multiple building floors, including stair traversal, shelf scanning, and package manipulation. The system uses a combination of reinforcement learning-trained locomotion policies and LLM-based task planning to handle novel environments without pre-mapping.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' Framework to Defend Against Jailbreaks
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new safety framework called Constitutional Classifiers that layers lightweight, independently trained classifier models around a base LLM to detect and block adversarial prompt injections in real time. Internal red-team testing showed a 92% reduction in successful jailbreaks compared to instruction-tuning-only defenses, with less than 2% increase in false refusals on benign prompts.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has started high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 gate-all-around transistor process, roughly two months ahead of its original roadmap. The node delivers a 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from NVIDIA and Apple shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Expanded Brain-Computer Interface Trials in Paralysis Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to expand its PRIME clinical trial to 50 additional participants with spinal cord injuries and ALS. Early trial data presented at a neuroscience conference showed participants achieving cursor control speeds approaching 90% of able-bodied mouse usage, with the implant maintaining signal fidelity beyond 18 months.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 'Behemoth' Model with 2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the largest model in its Llama 4 family under an open-source license, featuring a mixture-of-experts architecture with over 2 trillion total parameters. The model matches or exceeds proprietary frontier models on several reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, intensifying the debate about the competitive viability of open-weight AI development.
